title: pv-* change/fix .metadata.json
description: Mutable per-change state stored at {workFolder}/changes/{state}/{xxxx}/.metadata.json, alongside description.md / plan.md / history.md. A dotfile: it only exists once a change has at least one flag or a risk value. 'Missing file' / 'missing field' / '[]' all mean 'no flags'; a missing 'risk' means 'not yet assessed'. todo/ folders NEVER carry this file. The 'flags' enum is the canonical catalogue of framework flags: adding a flag = one enum value here + its icon/label in pv-status's FLAG_* maps, nothing else.

flags.description: Active status flags for this change. Order is not significant; consumers normalise to a fixed paint order (priority before workinprogress).

flagsLastModified.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last effective change to 'flags' (any add or remove). A single global timestamp, not one per flag. set-metadata.py writes it; no consumer reads it yet (reserved for future 'sort by recent activity' / 'stale flag' features).

risk.description: Median of pv-internal-tech-risks' 9 factors (0-10). Written by pv-how in step 3.1, right after plan.md is drafted, via set-metadata.py --set-risk. Absent = not yet assessed (fast entries, or a change still pending pv-how); no framework path ever writes null, but it's accepted for robustness when a file is hand-edited. Setting risk never touches flagsLastModified.
